name: The Raindrop Orchestra
description: Glowing raindrops become tiny musicians playing instruments on umbrellas and rooftops in a rainy city.
prompt: Rainy city street at night where glowing raindrops become tiny musicians playing violins, cellos, and trumpets on umbrellas and rooftops, reflections in puddles, warm streetlights, magical realism, highly detailed, no text, no logos.
caption: Listen closely—the rain is not just falling, it’s performing. 🎻🌧️
